req.title: List all tasks
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /tasks/ with a JSON array of all tasks, honouring optional skip and limit query parameters.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers GET /tasks/ returning a JSON array with optional skip/limit query parameters. I designed tests covering: (1) positive EP — empty DB returns empty array with HTTP 200; (2) positive EP — tasks present returns correct array with all schema fields; (3) BVA — skip=0 boundary (minimum allowed); (4) BVA — limit=1 boundary (minimum allowed ge=1); (5) BVA — limit=1000 boundary (maximum allowed le=1000); (6) NEG — limit=0 violates ge=1 constraint returns 422; (7) NEG — limit=1001 violates le=1000 returns 422; (8) NEG — skip=-1 violates ge=0 returns 422; (9) DT — skip and limit together paginate correctly; (10) EP — completed filter returns only matching tasks. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill constant-mutation, comparison-flip, and off-by-one mutants.

tests.name: test_list_tasks_empty_db_returns_200_and_empty_array
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.database import engine
from app import models

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_list_tasks_empty_db_returns_200_and_empty_array():
    r = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 0
    assert body == []

test_list_tasks_empty_db_returns_200_and_empty_array()

tests.name: test_list_tasks_with_tasks_returns_correct_schema_fields
preconditions: Database is empty; two tasks are created via POST
expected: Each item has id, title, description, completed, created_at fields
completed field is boolean False by default
trace: R-TASK-004 — nominal path with data present, schema field validation
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.database import engine
from app import models

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_list_tasks_with_tasks_returns_correct_schema_fields():
    client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task A", "description": "desc A", "completed": False})
    client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Task B", "description": "desc B", "completed": True})
    r = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 2
    titles = {t["title"] for t in body}
    assert titles == {"Task A", "Task B"}
    for task in body:
        assert "id" in task
        assert "title" in task
        assert "completed" in task
        assert "created_at" in task
    completed_vals = {t["title"]: t["completed"] for t in body}
    assert completed_vals["Task A"] == False
    assert completed_vals["Task B"] == True

test_list_tasks_with_tasks_returns_correct_schema_fields()

tests.name: test_list_tasks_skip_and_limit_paginate_correctly
preconditions: Database is empty; 5 tasks seeded in order
expected: Tasks are the 3rd and 4th created (index 2 and 3)
trace: R-TASK-004 — DT: both skip and limit applied together; catches offset/limit swap mutations
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.database import engine
from app import models

models.Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

client = TestClient(app)

def test_list_tasks_skip_and_limit_paginate_correctly():
    ids = []
    for i in range(5):
        resp = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": f"Task {i}"})
        ids.append(resp.json()["id"])
    r = client.get("/tasks/?skip=2&limit=2")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert len(body) == 2
    returned_ids = [t["id"] for t in body]
    assert returned_ids == [ids[2], ids[3]]

test_list_tasks_skip_and_limit_paginate_correctly()
